messages:
Mira (Design): Quick idea for the timeline: when someone selects two versions, show a compact 'version-diff overlay' that surfaces key deltas (latency, error, config changes) so folks can decide to rollback or route without jumping to a separate page. Thoughts?

Jon (PM): Love it. Support often sees people open 3 tabs to compare metrics. Inline diff would speed decisions. We should be careful about clutter — keep the overlay compact and dismissible.

Sasha (Frontend): Feels doable. Implementation note: overlay anchored to the timeline row, not full-screen. It should be keyboard reachable (select with space/enter) and closable with Esc. We'll need a11y guidance for announcements.

Diego (A11y): Announce on selection: aria-live="polite" announces "Comparing v12 and v14: latency up 8 percent, errors down". For the overlay itself, role="region" with aria-label="Version comparison" and focusable controls inside. Avoid trap unless it's modal.

Mira (Design): Copy sketch for overlay header: "Compare v12 1 v14" then a small summary line: "Latency +8% · Errors -2% · Config change: auth flag". Action row: [Rollback to v12] [Route % to v14] [Open full comparison].

Jon (PM): UX constraints: Rollback actions from overlay should follow the same safety rules (inline undo window for small deltas, escalate to modal if change >15% or 100%). Also log decision reason if it's a rollback.

Sasha (Frontend): Will add rule wiring. For small actions, clicking 'Rollback to v12' triggers a non-blocking confirm toast with undo. For larger rollbacks we'll open an alertdialog with a required short reason. CSS sketch for overlay pop:
```
.overlay { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); transform: translateY(8px); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .12s ease, transform .12s ease; }
.overlay.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .overlay { transition: none; }}
```

Diego (A11y): Good. A11y nit: ensure action buttons have accessible labels that include the version target, e.g., "Rollback to version 12". When the overlay appears, do NOT auto-focus the first button; instead move focus to a clearly labelled 'Close comparison' control unless user used keyboard to open it (then focus where user expects).

Mira (Design): Nice nuance. Also thinking about a compact diff graph: tiny sparkline overlay showing last 24h for each metric with legend toggles. Keep color contrast high for error/latency lines.

Jon (PM): Ops request: show last-deployment time and commit hash in small muted text. Also surface recent alerts badge if there were SLO breaches in last 24h. If SLO breach present, disable single-click rollback and force confirm dialog.

Sasha (Frontend): That will be a small metadata row. For performance let's lazy-load sparklines when overlay opens. We'll make sparklines a11y-friendly by providing textual summaries for screenreaders.

Diego (A11y): For textual summaries: concise SR line like "Latency increased 8 percent over 24 hours; mean 180ms" — include that in an sr-only element and announce via aria-live when sparklines finish loading. Keep SR messages <=120 chars where possible.

Mira (Design): Button copy options: A) "Rollback to v12" B) "Revert to v12" C) "Switch to v12". Which is clearest for users?

Jon (PM): Prefer A "Rollback to v12" — explicit about intent. For route action: "Route 10% to v14" and open a small percent picker inline. If user types a number >15% show the big-change modal.

Sasha (Frontend): Percent picker: inline editable chip, up/down arrows, keyboard accessible. We'll validate range and show inline errors. Also confirm keyboard shortcut: when overlay open, hitting 'r' focuses route percent. We'll document shortcuts in the help menu.

Diego (A11y): Keyboard shortcut care: only active when overlay has focus to avoid collisions. Announce shortcut availability in the overlay header text for SR users.

deploy-bot: Rollout note: v14 promoted to 35% at 2026-03-22T09:14:02Z (job id: 33221).

Mira (Design): Next steps: I'll add mockups with the header/copy variants and sparklines. @Sasha can you prototype the overlay interactions and lazy-loading? @Diego please paste the SR announcement templates for the overlay and sparklines. @Jon will you set product thresholds for single-click vs modal?

Jon (PM): I'll draft thresholds: single-click allowed for <=15% deltas and no SLO breaches; required confirm modal for >15% or SLO breach or target=100%. Will post in product doc.

Sasha (Frontend): I'll prototype and link a PR in two days.

Diego (A11y): Draft SR announcement samples I'll drop in a follow-up message. Quick SR sample: "Comparing versions 12 and 14: latency up 8 percent; errors down 2 percent; no recent SLO breaches." Keep short.

Mira (Design): Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll iterate on microcopy in Figma and ship a first pass to staging behind a feature flag.
